name: Com chay
summary: Crisp rice in three colours, plain white, green from pandan leaf, and purple from magenta leaf. Each tray is finished with scallion oil and pork floss.
origin: Chợ đêm Côn Đảo. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, 16 May 2025.
howToEat: Buy a tray. Most people take it away because seats are limited.
where: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in the open yard in front of the daily market.
priceBand: 100,000 đồng for one tray at one stall (Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, May 2025).
seoTitle: Com chay — crisp rice in Con Dao
seoDescription: Cơm cháy at the Côn Đảo night market comes in white, pandan green, and magenta, with scallion oil and pork floss.
